items.title: A graph-attentive GAN for rare-cell-aware single-cell RNA-seq data generation
items.title_zh: 一种用于稀有细胞感知单细胞RNA-seq数据生成的图注意力GAN
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）下游分析的一个核心挑战是高维小样本（HDSS）情形，且常因稀有细胞类型而加剧类别不平衡。这些因素阻碍了稳健的特征（基因）选择和细胞聚类，并限制了现有模拟器生成样本的真实性。我们提出GARAGE，一种图注意力稀有细胞感知单细胞数据生成方法，在先验噪声之外，用少量、注意力加权的真实细胞“泄漏”来增强生成器输入。具体来说，我们构建k近邻细胞图，并使用图注意力网络（GAT）优先选择可能代表欠采样（稀有）亚群的节点；这些高注意力细胞嵌入被注入生成器输入，以引导合成朝向数据流形中生物学上合理的区域，同时尊重细胞类型比例。这种注意力引导泄漏加速训练，减少模式丢失，并生成保留稀有细胞结构的真实合成细胞。在真实scRNA-seq基准上，GARAGE相比最先进基线改善了下游特征选择和聚类。总之，GARAGE通过将图注意力与对抗生成结合，直接应对scRNA-seq中的HDS

extra.description: A central challenge in downstream single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis is the high-dimensional, small-sample (HDSS) regime, often compounded by class imbalance from rare cell types. These factors hinder robust feature (gene) selection and cell clustering and limit the realism of samples generated by existing simulators. We introduce GARAGE , a G raph- A ttentive RA re-cell aware single-cell data GE neration that augments the generator’s input with a small, attention-weighted ‘leakage’ of real cells in addition to prior noise. Specifically, we build a k -nearest-neighbour cell graph and use a graph attention network (GAT) to prioritize nodes that likely represent under-sampled (rare) subpopulations; these high-attention cell embeddings are injected into the generator input to steer synthesis toward biologically plausible regions of the data manifold while respecting cell-type proportions. This attention-guided leakage accelerates training, reduces mode dropping, and yields realistic synthetic cells that preserve rare-cell structure. Across real scRNA-seq benchmarks, GARAGE improves downstream feature selection and clustering compared with state-of-the-art baselines. In summary, GARAGE directly addresses HDSS and rarity in scRNA-seq by coupling graph attention with adversarial generation to produce high-fidelity synthetic cells that enhance downstream analyses. The corresponding software is available at: https://github.com/RitwikGanguly/GARAGE .

items.title: Integration of polygenic risk with single cell methylation data using met-scDRS.
items.title_zh: 使用met-scDRS将多基因风险与单细胞甲基化数据整合。
items.summary_zh: 尽管大规模全基因组关联研究（GWAS）已识别出许多精神疾病性状的风险变异，但其功能含义仍 largely 未知。其风险的潜在机制之一是通过细胞背景依赖性表观遗传学如甲基化。先前方法侧重于将GWAS与单细胞转录组学整合，从而能够识别疾病风险关联的细胞类型内异质性。我们将此框架扩展为一种名为met-scDRS的方法，将GWAS与单细胞表观基因组学整合，并研究精神疾病风险如何通过单细胞分辨率的甲基化组学体现。我们提出一种方法，将单细胞甲基化组与GWAS识别的疾病相关基因在单细胞分辨率下整合。我们发现我们的方法在不同场景下校准良好且具有功效。然后我们分析了公开可用的人脑单细胞甲基化组数据集中的75种不同性状，并为每种性状的每个细胞生成疾病相关性评分。我们发现高脑特异性，主要细胞类型富集与已知发现一致。我们识别了沿大脑空间轴的精神疾病风险的细胞类型内异质性以及与疾病差异相关的亚群。最后，我们表明甲基

extra.description: Although large scale genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified many risk variants for psychiatric traits their functional implication remain largely unknown. One potential mechanism for their risk is through cellular context-dependent epigenetics such as methylation. Previous methodologies have focused on integrating GWAS with single cell transcriptomics, which allowed identification of within-cell-type heterogeneity in disease risk association. We extended this framework to provide a method called met-scDRS that integrates GWAS with single cell epigenomics and investigates how psychiatric disease risk can manifest through methylomics at single cell resolution. We propose an approach that integrates single cell methylomes with disease associated genes identified from GWAS at single-cell resolution. We found our method to be well calibrated and powered in different scenarios. We then analyzed a publicly available single cell methylome dataset of the human brain for 75 different traits and generated disease relevance scores for each cell for each trait. We find high brain specificity with major cell type enrichments congruent with known findings. We identify within-cell-type heterogeneity for psychiatric disease risk along the brain spatial axis as well as subpopulations that are differentially associated with diseases. Finally, we showed that genes with high correlation between methylation levels and disease relevance scores to be highly enriched in specific functional pathways such as synaptic formation and transmission. met-scDRS is freely available in GitHub as a python package under MIT license: https://github.com/bogdanlab/met-scDRS. Source code is also available from Zenodo with DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21841506. All dataset used in this work are publicly available. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: CALT-GNN: a graph neural network with cross-attention and long-tail experts for multi-omics cancer subtype classification
items.title_zh: CALT-GNN：一种用于多组学癌症亚型分类的交叉注意力和长尾专家图神经网络
items.summary_zh: 摘要 基于分子特征的癌症亚型分类对于表征肿瘤异质性、评估患者预后和支持精准治疗很重要。多组学整合提供了基因组、表观基因组、转录组和蛋白质组层面的互补分子信息。然而，多组学数据的高维性、复杂的跨组学关系和不平衡的亚型分布仍是主要挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出CALT-GNN，一种图神经网络框架，整合患者相似性图学习、基于交叉注意力的组学整合、长尾专家分类和可学习预测融合。该框架首先构建组学特异性患者相似性图，使用图卷积网络学习潜在患者表示，并通过相似性网络融合获得统一图。交叉注意力分支将CNA和DNA甲基化作为源模态，mRNA表达作为目标模态，建模互补关系。并行地，长尾专家分支使用主要和次要专家，配合原型引导路由，执行类别分布感知分类。两个分支的输出随后使用可学习全局权重组合。在八个TCGA多组学队列上的实验表明，CALT-GNN相对于代表性基线方法取得了有竞争力或可比的分类性能，并在对类别

extra.description: Abstract Cancer subtype classification based on molecular features is important for characterizing tumor heterogeneity, evaluating patient prognosis, and supporting precision treatment. Multi-omics integration provides complementary molecular information across genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic levels. However, the high dimensionality of multi-omics data, complex cross-omics relationships, and imbalanced subtype distributions remain major challenges. To address these issues, we propose CALT-GNN, a graph neural network framework that integrates patient-similarity graph learning, cross-attention-based omics integration, long-tail expert classification, and learnable prediction fusion. The framework first constructs omics-specific patient-similarity graphs, learns latent patient representations using graph convolutional networks, and obtains a unified graph through similarity network fusion. A cross-attention branch models complementary relationships between CNA and DNA methylation as source modalities and mRNA expression as the target modality. In parallel, a long-tail expert branch uses Major and Minor Experts with prototype-guided routing to perform class-distribution-aware classification. The outputs of the two branches are subsequently combined using a learnable global weight. Experiments on eight TCGA multi-omics cohorts showed that CALT-GNN achieved competitive or comparable classification performance relative to representative baseline methods and stable performance on Macro-F1 and MCC, which are sensitive to class imbalance. Ablation and subtype-level analyses further supported the complementary contributions of cross-omics interaction modeling and adaptive long-tail expert routing, although the magnitude of the improvements varied across cohorts and subtypes. These results suggest that CALT-GNN provides a methodological framework for multi-omics cancer subtype classification under complex cross-omics relationships and imbalanced subtype distributions.

items.title: ct-validation: an open framework for benchmarking target-indication evidence against clinical trial outcomes.
items.title_zh: ct-validation：一个用于将靶点-适应症证据与临床试验结果进行基准测试的开放框架。
items.summary_zh: 人类遗传证据为选择药物靶点提供了坚实基础。然而，将靶点-适应症证据与临床试验结果进行一致的基准测试一直受到专有数据和定制流程的阻碍。为解决此问题，我们提出了Python包ct-validation，它评估由特定证据来源支持的靶点-适应症对是否富集于临床进展。该包计算临床阶段转换的相对成功率（RS）和比值比（OR）及置信区间。它还支持基于本体的语义疾病匹配，并提供Python、命令行和模型上下文协议（MCP）接口。通过将Minikel等人（2024）的基准重新映射到实验因子本体（EFO），我们重现了他们的逐转换富集，任何转换的最大差异仅为1.4%。在系统性的3x3基准测试中，独立变化遗传证据和临床试验来源，我们发现单一精选开放临床试验来源重现了专有比较器的信号（RS = 2.92 vs 2.65；无肿瘤学时2.34 vs 2.55）。然而，聚合开放临床试验注册库压缩了这一信号（RS = 1.

extra.description: Human genetic evidence provides a strong foundation for selecting drug targets. However, consistent benchmarking of target-indication evidence against clinical trial outcomes has been hindered by proprietary data and customised pipelines. To address this, we present the Python package ct-validation, which evaluates whether target-indication pairs supported by specific evidence sources are enriched for clinical progression.This package computes relative success (RS) and odds ratios (OR) with confidence intervals across clinical phase transitions. It also supports ontology-based semantic disease matching and offers interfaces in Python, on the command line, and via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). By remapping the benchmark from Minikel et al. (2024) to the Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO), we reproduced their per-transition enrichment, with a maximum difference of only 1.4% across any transition.In a systematic 3x3 benchmark that independently varies the genetic evidence and clinical trial sources, we found that a single curated open clinical trial source reproduces the signal of the proprietary comparator (RS = 2.92 vs 2.65; 2.34 vs 2.55 without oncology). However, aggregating open clinical trial registries compresses this signal (RS = 1.52); this loss is primarily driven by the breadth of the indication data rather than the genetic evidence. ct-validation is implemented in Python (version 3.11 or higher), distributed via pip, and freely available at https://github.com/gero-science/ct-validation, with support for Python, command-line, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) interfaces. Archived code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22901497. Benchmark data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22901451. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: Spatial Transcriptomics As Rasterized Image Tensors (STARIT) characterizes cell states with subcellular molecular heterogeneity
items.title_zh: 空间转录组学作为栅格化图像张量（STARIT）以亚细胞分子异质性表征细胞状态
items.summary_zh: 基于成像的空间分辨转录组学（imSRT）技术提供了细胞内基因的高通量分子分辨率空间表征。传统的 imSRT 数据分析方法通过统计每个分割细胞中每个基因检测到的 mRNA 分子数来生成基因计数矩阵，从而识别细胞类型和状态，因此忽略了可用于定义细胞状态的亚细胞异质性。为了利用 imSRT 数据中的分子分辨率信息，并有可能基于亚细胞异质性识别细胞状态，我们开发了 STARIT（空间转录组学作为栅格化图像张量）。STARIT 将 imSRT 数据中分割细胞内的转录本转换为基于图像的张量表示，可与深度学习计算机视觉模型结合用于下游分析。使用模拟和真实 imSRT 数据，我们证明 STARIT 能区分转录上不同的细胞类型，并进一步根据亚细胞转录本定位区分细胞状态，而传统基因计数分析无法捕捉这一点。通过提供一个标准化框架来编码 imSRT 数据中的亚细胞分子信息，STARIT 将有助于更深入地理解亚细胞

extra.description: Imaging-based spatially resolved transcriptomics (imSRT) technologies provide high-throughput molecular-resolution spatial characterization of genes within cells. Conventional analysis methods to identify cell-types and states in imSRT data rely on gene count matrices derived from tallying the number of mRNA molecules detected for each gene per segmented cell, thereby overlooking subcellular heterogeneity that can be useful in defining cell states. To take advantage of the molecular-resolution information in imSRT data and potentially identify cell-states based on subcellular heterogeneity, we developed STARIT (Spatial Transcriptomics As Rasterized Image Tensors). STARIT converts transcripts within segmented cells in imSRT data into an image-based tensor representation that can be combined with deep learning computer vision models for downstream analysis. Using simulated and real imSRT data, we demonstrate that STARIT distinguishes transcriptionally distinct cell-types and further separates cell states based on subcellular transcript localization, which conventional gene count analysis fails to capture. By providing a standardized framework to encode subcellular molecular information in imSRT data, STARIT will enable deeper insights into subcellular heterogeneity and enhance the identification and characterization of cell-types and states that are overlooked by gene count representations.

items.title: Epithelial NF-κB shapes protective Treg cell responses to restrain intestinal inflammation.
items.title_zh: 上皮NF-κB塑造保护性Treg细胞反应以抑制肠道炎症。
items.summary_zh: 炎症消退依赖于组织区室之间的协调通信，然而肠上皮如何塑造其免疫微环境仍知之甚少。在这里，我们使用溃疡性结肠炎（UC）患者的结肠活检和能够组织范围可视化NF-κB活动的小鼠模型，结合单细胞RNA测序和分泌组分析来定义结肠炎期间的上皮通信。我们显示，矛盾的是，肠上皮细胞（IEC）由NF-κB驱动的促炎分泌组对恢复至关重要，并防止不受控制的炎症。在机制上，上皮NF-κB促进CCL22依赖性调节性T细胞（Treg细胞）募集，并促进耐受性、促修复的细胞状态，伴随脂质代谢相关的GDPD3和CCR4的诱导。在UC中，上皮NF-κB并非均匀激活，而是诱导选择性促炎转录程序，同时抑制调节T细胞募集的靶标。因此，我们识别了动态的上皮-免疫通信，并证明了一个保护性IEC NF-κB-Treg细胞轴对肠道炎症消退很重要。

extra.description: Inflammation resolution depends on coordinated communication between tissue compartments, yet how the intestinal epithelium shapes its immune microenvironment remains poorly understood. Here, using colonic biopsies from patients with ulcerative colitis (UC) and mouse models enabling tissue-wide visualization of NF-κB activity, we combine single-cell RNA sequencing and secretome analysis to define epithelial communication during colitis. We show that, paradoxically, the NF-κB-driven pro-inflammatory secretome of intestinal epithelial cells (IECs) is essential for recovery and prevents unrestrained inflammation. Mechanistically, epithelial NF-κB promotes CCL22-dependent regulatory T cell (Treg cell) recruitment and promotes a tolerogenic, pro-repair cell state, accompanied by induction of the lipid-metabolism-associated GDPD3 and CCR4. In UC, epithelial NF-κB is not uniformly activated but instead induces a selective pro-inflammatory transcriptional program while repressing targets regulating T cell recruitment. Thus, we identify dynamic epithelial-immune communication and demonstrate a protective IEC NF-κB-Treg cell axis important for resolution of intestinal inflammation.

items.title: Distilling Direct Effects via Conditional Differential Gene Expression Analysis.
items.title_zh: 通过条件差异基因表达分析提取直接效应。
items.summary_zh: 差异基因表达（DGE）分析是解释RNA测序数据的基础，但它将直接生物学效应与通过基因共表达传播的相关性混为一谈。在三个RNA测序数据集（包括一个基因组规模扰动测序实验）中，我们发现只有一小部分差异表达基因对目标性状有直接效应，而大多数是无方向或乘客基因，其关联通过其他基因介导。为区分直接效应基因，我们引入条件差异基因表达（CDGE）分析，一个检验每个基因与目标性状之间条件而非边际关联的框架。通过GhostKnockoff程序与lasso回归实现，CDGE提供错误发现率控制，基于现有DGE流程的汇总统计运行，并适应批次效应。CDGE识别的基因介导大多数其他差异表达基因的效应，并比DGE识别的基因在已知蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用和生物通路中显示更强的富集。这些结果表明该领域一直在系统性地过度解释DGE输出，区分直接与介导效应对优先考虑基因进行功能后续和治疗开发至关重要。为促进基于knockoff的

extra.description: Differential gene expression (DGE) analysis is foundational for interpreting RNA sequencing data, but it conflates direct biological effects with correlations propagated through gene co-expression. Across three RNA sequencing datasets (including a genome-scale perturb-seq experiment), we find that only a small fraction of differentially expressed genes have direct effects on the trait of interest, while the majority are undirected or passengers whose associations are mediated through other genes. To distinguish direct effect genes, we introduce conditional differential gene expression (CDGE) analysis, a framework that tests for conditional rather than marginal association between each gene and the trait of interest. Implemented via the GhostKnockoff procedure with lasso regression, CDGE delivers false discovery rate control, operates on summary statistics from existing DGE pipelines, and accommodates batch effects. The genes identified by CDGE mediate the effects of most other differentially expressed genes and show stronger enrichment for known protein-protein interactions and biological pathways than DGE-identified genes. These results suggest that the field has been systematically over-interpreting DGE outputs, and that distinguishing direct from mediated effects is essential for prioritizing genes for functional follow-up and therapeutic development. To facilitate public access to knockoff-based CDGE analysis, we have developed the R package "KnockoffCDGE" as an integrated implementation, which is freely available at https://github.com/GuJQ5/KnockoffCDGE (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23241517). Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: Computational deconvolution of drug sensitivity via single-cell–to–bulk transcriptome mapping
items.title_zh: 通过单细胞到 bulk 转录组映射进行药物敏感性的计算去卷积
items.summary_zh: 基础研究和生物医学研究中常规进行的分析通常报告来自异质细胞混合物的聚合信号。这些混合物反映了其来源组织和器官固有的解剖和功能复杂性。此类 bulk 测量掩盖了细胞特异性信号，从而阻碍了对 underlying 生物过程的准确解读。在此，我们介绍 CLIMB 和 CLIFF，一个两步机器学习框架，将 bulk RNA-seq 去卷积为细胞类型组成和表达，然后将 bulk 药物敏感性测量解析为细胞亚型和单细胞特异性谱。我们首先使用实验已知细胞类型比例的白血病细胞系体外混合物验证 CLIMB，然后将验证扩展到基于独立 scRNA-seq 参考构建的大规模跨数据集伪 bulk 分析，涵盖两种疾病背景和五种癌症类型——模拟实际应用中遇到的参考到目标不匹配——并表明 CLIMB 准确推断 bulk 样本的细胞组成，优于最先进的 bulk 去卷积方法。我们强调 CLIMB 在急性髓系白血病中的有效性，它

extra.description: Analyses routinely conducted in both fundamental research and biomedical studies often report aggregate signals derived from heterogeneous mixtures of cells. These mixtures reflect the intrinsic anatomical and functional complexity of the tissues and organs from which they are derived. Such bulk measurements obscure cell-specific signals, thereby hindering accurate interpretation of the underlying biological processes. Here, we introduce CLIMB and CLIFF, a two-step machine-learning framework that deconvolves bulk RNA-seq into cell-type composition and expression, and then resolves bulk drug sensitivity measurements into cell subtype- and single-cell-specific profiles. We first validate CLIMB using in-vitro mixtures of leukemic cell lines with experimentally known cell-type proportions, then extend this validation to large-scale, cross-dataset pseudo-bulk analyses built from independent scRNA-seq references across two disease contexts and five cancer types — mimicking the reference-to-target mismatches encountered in real applications — and show that CLIMB accurately infers the cellular composition of bulk samples, outperforming state-of-the-art bulk deconvolution methods. We emphasize CLIMB’s effectiveness in acute myeloid leukemia, where it offers highly accurate estimation of leukemic stem cell fractions across three test datasets and three patient cohorts. We then validate CLIFF, our algorithm for estimating cell subtype- and single-cell-specific drug sensitivity, first on the same in-vitro cell line mixtures using experimentally measured drug responses, and then through in-depth, realistic-scale pseudo-bulk simulations. We applied our deconvolution strategy to the beatAML cohort dataset, currently the most extensive database of ex-vivo drug screening data. This analysis generated a cell subtype–resolved drug sensitivity landscape for 121 compounds, revealing multiple compounds putatively active against leukemic stem cells, including midostaurin, A-674563, SNS-032, and foretinib. Collectively, our work introduces a general computational framework for resolving bulk functional measurements at cell-type and single-cell resolution, providing an attractive new computational tool for drug development and precision medicine.

items.title: CoMeDA: an integrated platform for compositional analysis of metabarcoding data with batch correction
items.title_zh: CoMeDA：一个用于 metabarcoding 数据组成分析并带批次校正的集成平台
items.summary_zh: 摘要 背景 由 16S rRNA 和内部转录间隔区（ITS）扩增子测序产生的 metabarcoding 数据本质上是组成性的，观察到的丰度代表相对而非绝对信息。忽略这种组成结构可能导致下游分析中的虚假结果。此外，多队列研究经常遭受由样本处理或测序平台差异引起的批次效应，如果处理不当，可能混淆真实生物信号。尽管有多种微生物组分析平台可用，但这些分析考虑并不总是作为用户可访问工作流的核心组件整合在一起。结果 我们开发了 CoMeDA，一个集成网络平台，将 metabarcoding 数据的组成结构和批次效应作为单一分析工作流的协调组件处理。该平台支持原始 FASTQ 文件和预分类分类单元表，使其兼容短读长和长读长测序技术。CoMeDA 通过概率估计进行零值处理，并应用中心对数比（CLR）变换作为默认归一化策略，随后进行自动批次效应校正，去除技术变异同时保留生物信号。下游分析，包括使用组成适当

extra.description: Abstract Background Metabarcoding data generated from 16S rRNA and internal transcribed spacer (ITS) amplicon sequencing are inherently compositional, with observed abundances representing relative rather than absolute information. Ignoring this compositional structure can lead to spurious results in downstream analyses. In addition, multi-cohort studies frequently suffer from batch effects arising from differences in sample processing or sequencing platforms, which may confound true biological signals if not properly addressed. Despite the availability of multiple microbiome analysis platforms, these analytical considerations are not always incorporated together as central components of user-accessible workflows. Results We developed CoMeDA, an integrated web-based platform that treats the compositional structure of metabarcoding data and batch effects as coordinated components of a single analytical workflow. The platform supports both raw FASTQ files and pre-classified taxa tables, making it compatible with both short-read and long-read sequencing technologies. CoMeDA performs zero handling through probabilistic estimation and applies centered log-ratio (CLR) transformation as the default normalization strategy, followed by automated batch effect correction that removes technical variation while preserving biological signals. Downstream analyses, comprising diversity assessment using compositionally appropriate metrics, differential abundance analysis with effect size estimation, co-occurrence network inference, and functional prediction for both bacterial and fungal communities, are performed within the same compositional framework. CoMeDA also implements split-CLR transformation for cross-dataset analyses, enabling cross-kingdom and paired-condition correlation analyses while reducing spurious correlations introduced by directly combining datasets with different compositional structures. Using simulated datasets and a mock community with known ground truth, we evaluated the contribution of individual analytical components, the behavior of the automated batch-correction strategy, and taxonomic classification accuracy. We further reanalyzed a published multi-cohort gout dataset, a pediatric Crohn’s disease bacterial-fungal dataset, and a PacBio long-read periodontitis dataset. Using these datasets, CoMeDA recovered biologically coherent patterns while also highlighting additional literature-supported findings across different study designs. Conclusions CoMeDA provides a compositionally coherent workflow in which normalization, batch correction, and downstream analysis follow a consistent analytical logic. The platform features an interactive web interface and requires no programming expertise. CoMeDA is freely available online without registration, and a standalone Docker image is provided for local deployment.

items.title: CardamomOT: A mechanistic optimal transport-based framework for gene regulatory network inference, trajectory reconstruction and generative modeling
items.title_zh: CardamomOT：一种基于机制最优传输的框架，用于基因调控网络推断、轨迹重建和生成建模
items.summary_zh: 从实验数据推断控制细胞分化 and 重编程等过程的基因调控网络（GRN）的一个关键挑战在于无法直接在单细胞水平测量蛋白质动态，这阻碍了建立调节因子活性与靶标响应之间的因果关系。在早期工作中，我们介绍了 CARDAMOM，一种使用 scRNA-seq 数据时间快照来校准 GRN 驱动的基因表达机制模型的算法。然而，该方法有几个局限性：它只能依赖时间点的相对顺序而非其精确标签，对蛋白质动态施加了限制性的准稳态假设，并依赖多个超参数。在此，我们提出 CardamomOT，一种基于相同机制模型的新方法，在机制最优传输框架内从数据中联合重建 GRN 和未观察到的蛋白质轨迹。通过纳入精确时间标签和来自文献的蛋白质动力学速率先验，并大幅减少所需超参数数量，我们的方法解决了这些局限性，并显著提高了 GRN 校准的准确性和稳健性。我们在计算机模拟和实验数据集上验证了我们的框架，展示了计算可扩展性，并在模拟数

extra.description: A key challenge in inferring gene regulatory networks (GRNs) governing cellular processes such as differentiation and reprogramming from experimental data lies in the impossibility of directly measuring protein dynamics at the single-cell level, which prevents establishing causal relationships between regulator activity and target responses. In earlier work, we introduced CARDAMOM, an algorithm that uses temporal snapshots of scRNA-seq data to calibrate a GRN-driven mechanistic model of gene expression. However, this method had several limitations: it could only rely on the relative ordering of time points rather than their exact labels, imposed restrictive quasi-stationary assumptions on protein dynamics, and depended on multiple hyperparameters. Here, we present CardamomOT, a new method based on the same mechanistic model that jointly reconstructs the GRN and unobserved protein trajectories from the data within a mechanistic optimal transport framework. By incorporating exact time labels and priors on protein kinetic rates from the literature, and substantially reducing the number of required hyperparameters, our approach addresses these limitations and substantially improves the accuracy and robustness of GRN calibration. We validate our framework on both in silico and experimental datasets, demonstrating computational scalability and consistently improved performance over state-of-the-art methods in both GRN and trajectory reconstruction on simulated datasets, and, on experimental datasets, reconstruction of cellular trajectories, velocity fields and latent protein levels that are mutually consistent, together with GRN structures consistent with known biology. We also show that these improvements make the calibrated mechanistic model suitable to be used as a generative model to generate testable predictions of cellular responses to unseen perturbations. To our knowledge, this is among the first methods to explicitly integrate mechanistic GRN inference, trajectory reconstruction, and simulation of realistic datasets into a unified framework for scRNA-seq time series analysis.

items.title: A new explainable AI pipeline for cancer cell segmentation and classification for microscopy images
items.title_zh: 一种用于显微镜图像中癌细胞分割和分类的新型可解释 AI 流水线
items.summary_zh: 摘要 背景 开发针对癌症的新型治疗方法需要大量时间和人力，尤其是对于罕见癌症（例如来源于间充质的癌症）。此外，这些罕见癌症通常获得的 research 关注较少，但仍需要充分分析。例如，对组织样本进行可信分析以识别癌症进展和细胞对候选疗法的反应，是开发某些治疗方法和药物的一项任务。因此，本研究工作开发了一种新的可解释深度学习流水线，用于从大规模荧光显微镜图像中准确、高通量且自主地识别转移细胞，可用于以低成本和高可信度评估细胞反应，并促进治疗方法的开发。结果 该流水线包括预训练且领域泛化的分割以识别单细胞，训练最新的自监督 transformer：基于 DINO 的模型以提供正常或转移分类，并利用可解释 AI 方法生成具有生物学意义的模型解释，以提升模型预测的可信度；这在未来临床应用中至关重要。与基于监督学习的模型相比，DINO 在仅训练分类器时实现了最佳可预测性（F1 加权分数超过 97%

extra.description: Abstract Background The development of novel therapeutic approaches to cancers requires significant time and labour, especially for uncommon cancers (e.g. of mesenchymal origin). In addition, these rare cancers typically receive less research attention but still need sufficient analysis. For example, a trustworthy analysis of tissue samples to identify cancer progression and cell response to candidate therapies is a task to develop certain treatments and drugs. Thus, this research work develops a new explainable Deep Learning pipeline for accurate, high-throughput and autonomous recognition of metastasising cells from large-scale fluorescence microscopy images, which can be used to evaluate cell response with low cost and high trustworthiness, and facilitate the therapeutic approaches development. Results The pipeline includes pre-trained and domain-generalised segmentation to identify single cells, training the latest self-supervised transformers: DINO-based models to provide normal or metastasising classification, and leveraging Explainable AI methods to produce biologically meaningful model explanations towards the trustworthiness of model predictions; this is crucial in future clinical applications. Compared to supervised learning-based models, DINO achieves the best predictability (over 97% F1-weighted score) when only training the classifier, and the most efficient downstream adaptation. Besides, all DINO-based models can classify successfully when finetuning the entire model (DINOv3 achieves the highest F1-weighted score with 98.35%). We have also used an additional cross-magnification test and a self- / weakly-supervised model comparison to discuss the generalisation ability and superiority of DINO-based models. Biologically accurate model explanations are produced via heatmaps and analysed through quantitative metrics and qualitative evaluation; the important cell regions in the model decision-making process align well with biological consensus. We also demonstrate that biologically meaningful cytoskeletal features can be detected and exploited by the developed pipeline for cancer cell classification, which facilitates the development of cytoskeleton-based diagnosis. Conclusion We develop a precise, efficient, and trustworthy pipeline that can facilitate the development of effective and bespoke cancer treatments via AI-assisted testing of the response of cancer cells to various treatments and drugs.

items.title: ParaDISM: precise mapping of short reads to genes with highly homologous regions
items.title_zh: ParaDISM：将短读段精确映射到具有高度同源区域的基因
items.summary_zh: 摘要 背景 具有高度相似基因组拷贝的基因（旁系同源基因、串联重复和假基因）对短读段高通量测序（srHTS）构成重大挑战。高序列相似性使得难以明确识别短读段的来源序列。这会导致错配伪影，并可能通过生物信息学流程传播，增加后续步骤（如单核苷酸变异检测）的错误率。结果 我们提出ParaDISM，这是一个优化标准比对以改善读段放置并减少高度同源序列中错配驱动假变异检测的流程。该流程使用参考序列的多序列比对来识别消歧位点，并仅在有无歧义序列特异性证据支持时将读段/读段对分配给某序列。ParaDISM采用保守的读段放置策略，将证据不足的读段报告为未分配，从而侧重于特异性与精确度（阳性预测值）而非灵敏度。可选的迭代优化程序从高置信度分配的读段中检测变异，更新参考序列以获得样本特异性读段放置证据，并重新处理剩余未分配读段，以减轻严格读段放置标准造成的灵敏度损失。我们使用大量计算模拟实验和Genome in

extra.description: Abstract Background Genes with highly similar genomic copies (paralogs, tandem duplications and pseudogenes) pose a major challenge for Short-Read High Throughput Sequencing (srHTS). High sequence similarity makes it difficult to unambiguously identify the sequences of origin of short reads. This results in misalignment artifacts which can propagate through bioinformatic pipelines and increase error rates in subsequent steps such as single nucleotide variant calling. Results We present ParaDISM , a pipeline that refines standard alignments to improve read placement and reduce misalignment-driven false variant calls in highly homologous sequences. The pipeline uses a multiple sequence alignment of reference sequences to identify disambiguating positions and assign a read/read pair to a sequence only when supported by unambiguous sequence-specific evidence. ParaDISM focuses on specificity and precision (positive predictive value) rather than sensitivity by adopting a conservative strategy of read placement and reporting reads with insufficient evidence for the gene of origin as unassigned. An optional iterative refinement procedure calls variants from confidently assigned reads, updates the reference sequences to gain sample-specific evidence for read placement, and re-processes remaining non-assigned reads to mitigate the loss of sensitivity caused by the stringent criteria for read placement. We evaluated the performance of ParaDISM both in terms of read alignment and the resulting short variant calls using extensive computational simulation experiments and the Genome in a Bottle HG002 benchmark. We applied ParaDISM to reanalyze two case studies: five public tumour exomes at the GNAQ/GNAQP1 locus, and 18 short-read sequencing datasets of patients diagnosed with Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease (15 exomes and 3 panel sequencing datasets). Compared to Bowtie2, BWA-MEM2 and minimap2, ParaDISM reduced the number of misalignment artifacts, thus increasing specificity and precision of subsequent single nucleotide variant calls. Conclusions ParaDISM refines BAM files to improve the precision of read placement and downstream analyses in highly homologous sequences. The pipeline can be used as a precision-focused add-on to standard bioinformatic pipelines before the variant calling step to provide a stronger level of evidence for variants called in regions of high homology. This approach is useful for applications where false positive variant calls have more severe consequences than false negative ones, such as identifying causal mutations for genetic disorders. In applications where experimental wet-lab confirmation of shortlisted variants is necessary, ParaDISM can be used to prioritise variants with strong support to reduce cost and effort spent on attempting to confirm false positive calls. ParaDISM can be used alongside the results of standard mappers to cross-check results and identify unreliable read placement and variants potentially caused by misalignment artifacts. The pipeline is open source and available under the MIT license at github.com/BioGeMT/ParaDISM.

<p<知识图谱推理因其能够有效缓解知识图谱中的数据不完整问题而受到广泛关注。现有方法多依赖于嵌入模型或链式规则，但在可解释性与表达能力方面仍存在明显局限。一方面，基于闭合路径的规则学习仅能建模线性链式依赖，难以捕捉图结构中存在的多路径交互与层次化语义关系；另一方面，基于统计指标的传统方法通常采用“穷举+验证”策略，不仅在大规模图谱中面临高昂计算成本，也难以充分挖掘规则间的深层语义关联，从而制约了推理性能的进一步提升。为此，提出一种基于对比学习的图结构规则学习方法CGRL（contrastive graph rule learning），以同时提升推理的表达能力与可解释性。CGRL 通过三重机制实现高效规则学习：首先，采用自适应聚类策略为节点生成软标签，引入类别语义以增强规则泛化能力；其次，设计多跳邻域采样方法构建语义子图，并生成高质量正负规则样本；最后，利用基于 Transformer 的编码器学习规则表示，并通过对比学习将规则对映射至统一向量空间以优化语义一致性判别。在6个公开知识图谱补全任务上的实验结果表明，CGRL 取得了显著性能提升。在FB15k-237 和 WN18RR这种关系结构相对复杂的数据集下，其MRR 指标平均提升 6.04%，Hits@1 指标平均提升 16.26%，显著优于现有基线方法，验证了其在学习高质量图结构规则与提升推理效果方面的有效性。</p<

items.title: 基于威胁感知的Tor多路径选择
items.title_zh: 基于威胁感知的Tor多路径选择
items.summary_zh: 随着机器学习和深度学习的发展应用,攻击者可以通过Tor用户链路上的恶意节点以及恶意AS对其进行流量分析,从而对Tor用户进行去匿名化攻击。目前,常见的针对流量分析攻击的防御方法有两类:一类是通过插入虚拟数据包,或者延迟真实数据包从而改变流量特征,这种方法会引入带宽和时延开销;另一类将用户流量分割并通过多个路径传输从而进行防御,这种方法缺少对电路上存在的恶意节点以及恶意AS的感知,当攻击者搜集到完整流量踪迹时,依旧难以抵御流量分析对Tor用户的去匿名化攻击。为了弥补多路径防御方法在路径选择上存在的缺乏威胁感知的问题,提出了融合恶意节点感知以及恶意AS感知的基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。首先提出一种改进的节点距离度量的方法,然后使用改进后的距离度量,基于K-Mediods算法对节点进行聚类,提高了恶意节点的检测效果;之后改进了AS感知算法,提高了匿名性要求;最后融合恶意节点检测以及AS感知算法

items.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 基于多视图多样性学习的联合谱嵌入聚类算法
items.title_zh: 基于多视图多样性学习的联合谱嵌入聚类算法

items.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.title_zh: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.summary_zh: 随着云计算与空天地海一体化通信网络的深度融合, 各种复杂应用场景的出现使得组合服务的种类和数量急剧增多, 结构也变得复杂。在云网融合环境下, 用户移动设备和边缘服务器等硬件能力有限, 能耗问题成为组合服务进行动态重构不可忽略的重要因素。此外, 传统方法并未考虑空天地海不同场景下用户对不同服务质量(QoS)属性需求的差异性, 使得组合服务的交付结果并不令人满意。为了解决上述问题, 提出一种基于多目标粒子群优化(PSO)的组合服务动态重构方法。该方法首先根据重构原子服务的三维空间地理位置和功能进行聚类, 有效解决在云网融合环境下服务规模庞大情况下的搜索空间爆炸问题; 然后通过能耗计算模型得到服务调用的综合能耗, 并将其作为动态重构的优化目标之一, 结合服务的多种QoS属性进行多目标寻优, 最终生成符合用户需求且能耗较低的重构方案。实验结果表明, 该方法在云网融合环境下节约能耗和应对较大候选服务

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

items.title_zh: 面向物联网终端的云边协同日志异常检测技术

items.title: ValidPoC：基于大语言模型的PoC-Nuclei模板生成与漏洞复现验证方法
items.title_zh: ValidPoC：基于大语言模型的PoC-Nuclei模板生成与漏洞复现验证方法
items.summary_zh: <p<外部漏洞知识是支撑大语言模型开展自动化渗透测试与漏洞复现的重要信息来源。然而，公开漏洞利用材料通常来源复杂、表示形式异构，广泛存在于脚本代码、HTTP请求片段、命令行示例以及自然语言说明文档中，缺乏统一的描述规范与明确的语义边界。现有方法虽然能够通过漏洞知识检索、利用代码生成等方式辅助漏洞利用，但仍面临漏洞利用语义提取困难、环境适配能力不足以及模型幻觉等问题，导致自动化漏洞复现成功率受限。针对上述问题，提出一种基于大语言模型的自动化漏洞复现方法ValidPoC。该方法以公开漏洞利用材料为输入，通过构建PoC语义解析、PoC中间表示建模以及PoC-Nuclei模板生成流程，实现异构漏洞利用材料向标准化漏洞利用模板的自动转换。其中，定义了面向漏洞复现的PoC语义模型，统一描述请求构造、载荷生成、执行依赖与验证判据等关键利用逻辑；设计了基于Semgrep辅助的P

extra.description:
<p<外部漏洞知识是支撑大语言模型开展自动化渗透测试与漏洞复现的重要信息来源。然而，公开漏洞利用材料通常来源复杂、表示形式异构，广泛存在于脚本代码、HTTP请求片段、命令行示例以及自然语言说明文档中，缺乏统一的描述规范与明确的语义边界。现有方法虽然能够通过漏洞知识检索、利用代码生成等方式辅助漏洞利用，但仍面临漏洞利用语义提取困难、环境适配能力不足以及模型幻觉等问题，导致自动化漏洞复现成功率受限。针对上述问题，提出一种基于大语言模型的自动化漏洞复现方法ValidPoC。该方法以公开漏洞利用材料为输入，通过构建PoC语义解析、PoC中间表示建模以及PoC-Nuclei模板生成流程，实现异构漏洞利用材料向标准化漏洞利用模板的自动转换。其中，定义了面向漏洞复现的PoC语义模型，统一描述请求构造、载荷生成、执行依赖与验证判据等关键利用逻辑；设计了基于Semgrep辅助的PoC语义解析机制，从代码脚本与自然语言材料中抽取漏洞触发相关语义；构建了基于Nuclei模板的漏洞复现载体，实现漏洞利用逻辑的结构化表达与自动执行。为提高漏洞复现结果的可靠性，进一步提出基于“执行—评估—修复”闭环反馈优化机制，并建立L1（可解析执行）、L2（条件匹配成功）和L3（漏洞真实复现）三级验证模型，对漏洞触发结果进行多源证据交叉验证。在67个真实漏洞复现任务上的实验结果表明，ValidPoC能够有效提升自动化漏洞复现能力。与现有自动化渗透测试方法相比，ValidPoC取得76.12%的Pass@3漏洞复现成功率，较PentestAgent提升4.48个百分点，较PentestGPT提升43.28个百分点；同时，在Token消耗和运行时间方面均表现出较好的效率优势。实验结果验证了所提方法在异构漏洞利用材料理解、PoC模板生成以及漏洞复现验证方面的有效性。</p<


计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(10): 2611-2631.

items.title: 基于自适应多分辨率特征解耦的动态异构网络时间序列分类
items.title_zh: 基于自适应多分辨率特征解耦的动态异构网络时间序列分类
items.summary_zh: <p<随着云边端协同计算与物联网技术的深度融合，动态异构网络中的海量终端已成为网络安全体系中的核心防护对象。这些智能终端在持续运行过程中产生网络流量、工控传感日志等多元时间序列数据，承载着终端行为的完整语义信息。因此，对此类时间序列数据进行精准分类是实现终端威胁检测的关键技术。然而，终端异质性引发的数据分布不均衡问题，使现有时序分类模型面临三重挑战：1）受限于固定分辨率的处理范式，模型难以捕捉不同时间尺度下的多粒度威胁特征；2）现有方法通常将所有分辨率特征映射至统一高维空间，忽视了不同时间分辨率在特征维度分布上的内在差异，导致噪声引入与特征冗余，制约了模型在计算资源受限的边缘终端上的部署适配能力；3）使用多分辨率进行联合推理，各分辨率分支的特征提取与融合过程带来显著的计算与存储开销，加剧了轻量化部署与高精度检测之间的固有矛盾。为了解决时间分辨率与特征维度适配的问

extra.description:
<p<随着云边端协同计算与物联网技术的深度融合，动态异构网络中的海量终端已成为网络安全体系中的核心防护对象。这些智能终端在持续运行过程中产生网络流量、工控传感日志等多元时间序列数据，承载着终端行为的完整语义信息。因此，对此类时间序列数据进行精准分类是实现终端威胁检测的关键技术。然而，终端异质性引发的数据分布不均衡问题，使现有时序分类模型面临三重挑战：1）受限于固定分辨率的处理范式，模型难以捕捉不同时间尺度下的多粒度威胁特征；2）现有方法通常将所有分辨率特征映射至统一高维空间，忽视了不同时间分辨率在特征维度分布上的内在差异，导致噪声引入与特征冗余，制约了模型在计算资源受限的边缘终端上的部署适配能力；3）使用多分辨率进行联合推理，各分辨率分支的特征提取与融合过程带来显著的计算与存储开销，加剧了轻量化部署与高精度检测之间的固有矛盾。为了解决时间分辨率与特征维度适配的问题，提出了面向动态异构网络的自适应多分辨率表示学习（adaptive multi-resolution representation learning，AdaMRL）模型，实现了时间分辨率与特征维度的双向对齐解耦。首先，构建了多分辨率嵌套表征架构，提出多分辨率与嵌套维度自适应匹配机制，为每个时间分辨率独立配备嵌套表示学习层，自动选择最优的维度进行嵌套表示学习；其次，提出了多分辨率联合损失监督机制，在训练阶段对各分辨率表征进行同步约束，增强跨分辨率特征的鲁棒性并加快模型收敛；最后，设计了自适应维度选择与集成策略，在推理阶段为不同分辨率动态匹配最优特征维度，并通过软投票机制实现协同决策。在10个UEA多变量时间序列基准数据集与工业物联网边缘安全基准数据集Edge-IIoTset上的广泛实验表明，AdaMRL达到了当前先进的分类性能。与基准模型相比，所提方法平均分类准确率提升0.78个百分点，并在最佳自适应配置下将冗余特征参数计算量降低27.3%，在检测精度与计算效率之间实现了有效平衡，为边缘异质终端的实时安全防护提供了有力支撑。</p<


计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(10): 2632-2649.

items.title: 基于双重异常感知的时间序列异常检测
items.title_zh: 基于双重异常感知的时间序列异常检测
items.summary_zh:
<p<时间序列的异常检测在金融风控、故障诊断等领域中有着重要的应用价值，其关键在于构建能够有效区分正常与异常模式的表征空间。然而时间序列内在的特点以及异常的稀缺性，导致学习具有强判别能力的表征映射函数颇为困难，且泛化能力受限。与此同时，对比表示学习通过构建清晰可区分的样本实例的表征空间，为时序异常检测提供了更为自然且富有前景的解决方案。鉴于此，设计了基于双重异常感知的Transformer模型（DAT），通过异常注入和异常感知的手段，使DAT提前捕获异常样本的复杂特征。此外，通过结合上下文对比损失函数指导双分支学习正常样本与异常样本之间更本质、更具区分度的语义特征。实验在5个公开数据集上进行验证，并与21种基线模型进行对比。结果表明DAT在公共数据集上优于基线模型的平均性能，甚至在MSL和PSM数据集上能够达到SOTA。</p<

items.title: 融合动态原型与自监督迁移学习的跨域图异常检测
items.title_zh: 融合动态原型与自监督迁移学习的跨域图异常检测
items.summary_zh: <p<跨域图异常检测旨在利用源域图中的正常与异常样本信息，在标注稀缺的目标域图上实现有效的异常识别。然而，源域与目标域之间通常存在显著的图结构差异与特征分布偏移，导致源域知识难以有效迁移至目标域，限制了跨域泛化能力。此外，目标域缺乏标注信息，易引发训练过程中的决策边界模糊和预测不稳定问题。为解决上述问题，提出了一种融合动态原型与自监督迁移学习的跨域图异常检测方法。首先，基于源域中的正常与异常样本构建语义原型，并结合双向引导策略，实现源域原型与目标域节点在共享语义空间中的知识对齐，从而缓解跨域图之间的分布偏移。为进一步增强原型的稳定性与语义判别性，引入指数移动平均机制实现原型的动态更新；随后，通过最小化目标域节点嵌入的熵值，增强特征表示的区分度，以缓解决策边界模糊问题；最后，综合利用源域模型与无监督方法在目标域数据上生成异常评分的伪标签，并筛选高置信度样本作为弱监

extra.description:

items.title: 基于跨标签分配知识蒸馏的端到端目标检测方法
items.title_zh: 基于跨标签分配知识蒸馏的端到端目标检测方法

<p<1对1标签分配规则在去除后处理步骤中的非极大值抑制（non-maximum suppression，NMS）和构建无NMS的端到端检测范式中发挥了巨大作用。然而，这种严格的样本匹配规则导致训练过程中正样本数量显著减少，使得模型在特征表示学习阶段难以充分挖掘数据中的潜在语义信息，学习效率低下。为此，提出了一种跨标签分配知识蒸馏（cross-label assignment knowledge distillation，CAKD）方法，用于实现端到端的目标检测。该方法将知识蒸馏的迁移学习机制与端到端目标检测算法相结合以弥补现有1对1标签分配规则的缺陷，为知识蒸馏框架用在训练端到端检测模型建立了一条有效的知识迁移路径。具体地，该方法首先将学生模型的多尺度特征传递到教师模型的检测头中。然后，将学生—教师跨标签分配预测与教师的预测用于计算蒸馏损失。这种方式避免了直接强制学生模仿教师的特征导致的特征混乱、语义错位的问题。此外，设计了一种有效的任务感知匹配度量方式，综合考虑了分类和回归质量，避免了分类和定位任务之间没有相关性的问题。在COCO数据集上进行了大量实验证明了提出方法的有效性。提出的跨标签分配知识蒸馏方法在非端到端FCOS基线模型上的均值平均精度（mean average precision，<italic<mAP</italic<）达到了38.8%的无NMS检测性能，其相较于原始有NMS的检测性能实现了2.2个百分点的精度增益。</p<


计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(10): 2682-2696.

items.title: 基于大语言模型的库存调度决策方法
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的库存调度决策方法
items.summary_zh: <p<库存调度在现代供应链中扮演着至关重要的角色，其核心目标在于通过合理的库存调度平衡生产与需求之间的关系。然而，随着市场需求的不确定性和商品属性的多样化，基于经验的传统库存调度方法往往难以有效地将商品属性与需求波动结合考虑，并且其决策结果缺乏可解释性，使得其库存调度结果难以追溯原因且信任度较低。另一方面，大语言模型的出现为库存调度决策问题的可解释性提供了新的解决方案。然而，直接将库存调度流程中的补货策略引入推理过程会导致推理过程的误差积累，导致推理结果不稳定。针对上述问题，不仅要考虑推理过程的合理性，还要关注最终决策效果的优化。为了解决上述挑战，一种基于大语言模型的库存调度多步推理框架InvLLM被提出。主要贡献如下：1）基于库存调度工作流程设计了一种自校准的多步推理方法；2）提出了一种用于库存调度决策的多目标平衡优化方法。此外，为了解决推理微调阶段的偏差问题

计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(10): 2715-2732.

items.title: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: Spatially Informed and Direction Sensitive Representation Learning for Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 面向空间转录组学的空间信息感知和方向敏感表示学习
items.summary_zh: 细胞状态由内在基因表达程序和细胞所在的空间微环境共同塑造。空间转录组学使这一背景变得可测量，但有效的表示学习需要同时捕获空间信息分子信号和细胞间组织。现有方法只能部分解决这些挑战：传统基因选择可能忽略空间结构化信号，而编码细胞-细胞关系的方法通常要么将细胞的微环境简化为仅邻近性，丢弃方向，要么依赖与任意组织框架绑定的绝对坐标。因此，具有相似邻居距离但不同空间组织的细胞可能获得过于相似的表示，尽管它们经历着塑造其细胞状态的不同生物背景。我们介绍Tessera，一个空间表示学习框架，同时解决分子选择和细胞背景问题。Tessera将空间信息基因选择与几何归纳偏置相结合，将每个细胞置于其局部组织环境中。通过建模相对细胞-细胞关系，Tessera具有平移不变性同时保留方向，允许邻近细胞根据其空间背景和细胞状态做出不同贡献。在留出组织和技术上，Tessera在表示质量上优于现有空间基础模型，并零样本泛

extra.description: Cellular states are shaped by both intrinsic gene expression programs and the spatial microenvironment in which cells reside. Spatial transcriptomics makes this context measurable, but effective representation learning requires capturing both spatially informative molecular signals and intercellular organization. Existing approaches address these challenges only partially: conventional gene selection can overlook spatially structured signals, while methods for encoding cell-cell relationships often either reduce a cell's microenvironment to proximity alone, discarding direction, or rely on absolute coordinates tied to an arbitrary tissue frame. Consequently, cells with similar neighbor distances but distinct spatial organization may receive overly similar representations, despite experiencing different biological contexts that shape their cellular states. We introduce Tessera, a spatial representation learning framework that addresses both molecular selection and cellular context. Tessera combines spatially informed gene selection with a geometric inductive bias that contextualizes each cell within its local tissue environment. By modeling relative cell-cell relationships, Tessera is translation-invariant while preserving direction, allowing neighboring cells to contribute differently according to their spatial context and cellular state. Across held-out tissues and technologies, Tessera outperforms existing spatial foundation models in representation quality and generalizes zero-shot to contexts up to $16\times$ larger than those seen during training.

items.title: gpuGEM: GPU-based linear optimisation of genome-scale metabolic models
items.title_zh: gpuGEM：基于GPU的基因组尺度代谢模型线性优化
items.summary_zh: 摘要：基因组尺度代谢模型在重复优化工作流中日益挑战CPU线性规划求解器。我们提出gpuGEM，一个使用NVIDIA cuOpt进行基于GPU的GEM优化的开源Python库，具有针对HiGHS和Gurobi验证的尺寸自适应设置。在涵盖四个数量级问题规模的十个模型基准套件中，gpuGEM相对于每个模型更快的HiGHS对偶单纯形和内点法实现了1.1倍至94倍的加速。gpuGEM在十个模型中的三个上也优于Gurobi，加速为1.6倍至2.5倍。在候选基因优先级工作流中，gpuGEM将端到端查询时间从41秒减少到21秒。可用性与实现：gpuGEM在MIT许可证下发布于https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM和PyPI（pip install gpugem）。存档版本（v0.1.2）可在https://zenodo.org/rec

extra.description: Summary: Genome-scale metabolic models increasingly challenge CPU linear-programming solvers in repeated-optimisation workflows. We present gpuGEM, an open-source Python library for GPU-based GEM optimisation using NVIDIA cuOpt, with size-adaptive settings validated against HiGHS and Gurobi. Across a ten-model benchmark suite spanning four orders of magnitude in problem size, gpuGEM achieved speed-ups of 1.1x to 94x relative to the faster of the HiGHS dual-simplex and interior-point methods for each model. gpuGEM also outperformed Gurobi on three of ten models, with speed-ups of 1.6x to 2.5x. In a candidate-gene prioritisation workflow, gpuGEM reduced end-to-end query time from 41 s to 21 s. Availability and Implementation: gpuGEM is released under the MIT licence at https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM and on PyPI (pip install gpugem). An archived release(v0.1.2) is available at https://zenodo.org/records/23422813. gpuGEM requires an NVIDIA GPU, Python 3.11 or later, CUDA 12 and cuOpt 26.6 or later. cuOpt requires a GPU with Volta architecture or newer (compute capability 7.0 or newer). Contact: ronan.mt.fleming@gmail.com Supplementary information: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: Truecell reproduces R Seurat's single-cell analysis outputs natively in the Python ecosystem
items.title_zh: Truecell 在 Python 生态中原生复现 R Seurat 的单细胞分析输出
items.summary_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序分析主要使用 Seurat（R）或 Scanpy（Python），选择通常由编程语言偏好驱动。然而，默认情况下，这些工具产生不同的可变特征、邻居图、聚类和标记基因。需要 Python（支持大多数深度学习、基础模型和代理工具）的实验室必须在无法复现 Seurat 结果的框架中重新实现 Seurat 分析。Truecell 被开发为 Seurat 接口的 Python 实现，保留函数名称、参数、默认设置和对象模型，以促进分析的无缝转移。在十八个与 R Seurat 的配对端到端评估中，确定性输出匹配到浮点精度，并且折叠变化顺序在所有九个差异表达测试中相同。在三个数据集上的三臂基准测试中，固定用户参数和每个工具 20 个种子，Truecell 在所有 12 个数据集和分辨率设置组合中比配置 Seurat 的 Scanpy 更接近地复现 Seurat 的聚类。Truecell

extra.description: Single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses predominantly use either Seurat (R) or Scanpy (Python), with the choice often driven by programming language preference. However, by default, these tools produce divergent variable features, neighbour graphs, clusters, and marker genes. Laboratories requiring Python, which supports most deep-learning, foundation-model, and agent tools, must re-implement Seurat analyses in a framework that does not replicate Seurat's results. Truecell was developed as a Python implementation of the Seurat interface, preserving function names, arguments, default settings, and the object model to facilitate seamless transfer of analyses. In eighteen paired end-to-end evaluations against R Seurat, deterministic outputs matched to floating-point precision, and fold-change order was identical across all nine differential expression tests. In a three-arm benchmark on three datasets, with fixed user parameters and 20 seeds per tool, Truecell more closely reproduced Seurat's clustering than a Seurat-configured Scanpy in all 12 combinations of dataset and resolution settings. Truecell's marker genes and enriched pathways were also closer to Seurat's than Scanpy's were, and pseudobulk DESeq2 reproduced Seurat's gene lists with a Jaccard index ranging from 0.95 to 1.00. This agreement reflects fidelity to Seurat rather than biological correctness.

items.title: VGL-stGen: Learning a shared multimodal model for lung histology and spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: VGL-stGen：学习肺组织学和空间转录组学的共享多模态模型
items.summary_zh: VGL-stGen是一个多模态大语言模型，从预训练医学视觉-语言模型改编而来，使用配对的肺H&E和空间转录组学及单细胞参考。训练整合了图像-表达和表达-细胞类型配对，基因条件伪标签将转录组细胞类型监督转移到组织学图像。一个部署的检查点支持十三项评估任务，涵盖组织和细胞类型分类、基因预测以及从组织学、细胞身份和观察到的基因表达组合进行条件表达完成。任务特定解码产生分类标签、基因列表和结构化表达水平。对于条件完成，固定查询基因身份并自回归预测其水平可改善结构化预测。受控适应表明，将监督限制在请求的表达水平标记上可以进一步改善图像条件完成。图像置换实验表明，正确配对的组织学增加了超出观察表达的信息。外部分类部分依赖具有共享注释谱系的计算参考，一些H&E来源在癌症训练或模型开发期间被暴露。在这些条件下，VGL-stGen展示了医学视觉-语言骨干如何从空间转录组学和组织学中学习，通过共享生成建模连接

extra.description: VGL-stGen is a multimodal large language model adapted from a pretrained medical vision-language model using paired lung H&E and spatial transcriptomics with single-cell references. Training integrates image-expression and expression-cell-type pairs, and gene-conditioned pseudo-labels transfer transcriptomic cell-type supervision to histology images. One deployed checkpoint supports thirteen evaluated tasks spanning tissue and cell-type classification, gene prediction and conditional expression completion from combinations of histology, cell identity and observed gene expression. Task-specific decoding produces categorical labels, gene lists and structured expression levels. For conditional completion, fixing queried gene identities and predicting their levels autoregressively improves structured prediction. Controlled adaptation shows that restricting supervision to requested expression-level tokens can further improve image-conditioned completion. Image-permutation experiments indicate that correctly paired histology adds information beyond observed expression. External classification relies partly on computational references with shared annotation lineage, and some H&E sources were exposed during cancer training or model development. Within these conditions, VGL-stGen demonstrates how a medical vision-language backbone can learn from spatial transcriptomics and histology to connect tissue morphology and molecular states through shared generative modeling.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Mapping the spatial architecture of glioblastoma from core to edge delineates niche-specific tumor cell states and intercellular interactions
items.title_zh: 从核心到边缘绘制胶质母细胞瘤的空间结构， delineates 生态位特异性肿瘤细胞状态和细胞间相互作用
items.summary_zh: 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）的治疗耐药性主要由该疾病典型的广泛多层次异质性驱动。尽管在阐明GBM的基因组和转录异质性方面取得了重大进展，但在空间层面定义这种异质性仍存在关键知识空白。为解决此问题，我们采用空间转录组学绘制GBM生态系统的结构。这揭示了由基因表达和空间定位共同定义的肿瘤细胞状态，以及沿肿瘤核心-边缘轴组成变化的多细胞生态位。配体-受体相互作用分析揭示了复杂的细胞间通讯网络，包括生态位和区域特异性相互作用。最后，我们发现CD8+GZMK+ T细胞与LYVE1+ CD163+髓系细胞在血管区域共定位，提示免疫逃逸的潜在机制。这些发现为GBM肿瘤微环境提供了新见解，突出了以前未认识到的空间组织和细胞间相互作用模式，以及破坏促肿瘤相互作用和克服免疫耐药的新治疗途径。

extra.description: Treatment resistance in glioblastoma (GBM) is largely driven by the extensive multi-level heterogeneity that typifies this disease. Despite significant progress toward elucidating GBM's genomic and transcriptional heterogeneity, a critical knowledge gap remains in defining this heterogeneity at the spatial level. To address this, we employed spatial transcriptomics to map the architecture of the GBM ecosystem. This revealed tumor cell states that are jointly defined by gene expression and spatial localization, and multicellular niches whose composition varies along the tumor core-edge axis. Ligand-receptor interaction analysis uncovered a complex network of intercellular communication, including niche- and region-specific interactions. Finally, we found that CD8+GZMK+ T cells colocalize with LYVE1+ CD163+ myeloid cells in vascular regions, suggesting a potential mechanism for immune evasion. These findings provide novel insights into the GBM tumor microenvironment, highlighting previously unrecognized patterns of spatial organization and intercellular interactions, and novel therapeutic avenues to disrupt tumor-promoting interactions and overcome immune resistance.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
items.title_zh: 关节、相机、开拍！为任意骨架共同生成3D运动和视频
items.summary_zh: 视频生成模型现在可以描绘非常逼真的运动。然而如何将这种运动用于像素之外尚不清楚：为特定3D资产制作动画并在其3D场景中重放动画。例如，视频模型可以展示一只猴子跳过横杆，但它无法将那次跳跃作为可重放的3D运动返回到3D场景中。这里我们提出一个模型，为任何提供的骨架直接共同生成视频和3D运动，以及一个将此运动配准到场景的相机。先前的视频-运动模型要么只处理人体骨架，通常增加数十亿参数，要么从生成的2D姿态图三角化3D运动。我们改为将3D运动保留在支持任意骨架的单独模型中，并通过少量交叉注意力层将其连接到预训练视频模型。这种分离让运动模型首先从纯运动数据学习骨架如何运动，这比配对视频更容易获取和增强。此外，我们的模型学习在视频帧中定位每个关节，这让我们恢复相机并将3D运动放置在场景中。为了跨许多骨架训练，我们使用生成式视频编辑器将动画3D资产放置在适合其动作的场景中，策划编辑使其已知运动保持有效

extra.description: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For instance, a video model can show a monkey jumping over a crossbar, but it cannot return that jump as replayable 3D motion placed in the 3D scene. Here we present a model that directly co-generates the video and 3D motion for any supplied rig, along with a camera that registers this motion to the scene. Prior video-motion models either handle only human skeletons, often adding billions of parameters, or triangulate 3D motion from generated 2D pose maps. We instead keep 3D motion in a separate model that supports arbitrary skeletons, and connect it to a pretrained video model through a small set of cross-attention layers. This separation lets the motion model first learn how skeletons move from motion-only data, which is easier to obtain and augment than paired video. Additionally, our model learns to locate each joint in the video frames, which lets us recover the camera and place the 3D motion in the scene. To train across many skeletons, we use a generative video editor to place animated 3D assets in scenes suited to their actions, curating the edits so their known motion remains valid. Together with human and robot video, this yields nearly 200K training pairs. Our evaluations demonstrate that our model animates diverse rigs from text more faithfully than video-first pipelines, and its motion responds to the surrounding scene. It also turns video into rig motion, rig motion into video, and enables keyframe-based control of the 3D motion. Videos and additional results are available on our project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/par/projects/jca/.

items.title: Planning under Noise with Neural Operators
items.title_zh: 用神经算子在有噪声下规划
items.summary_zh: 在不确定控制执行噪声下规划需要在多样环境中具有可靠的反馈策略。我们介绍Planning Under Noise（PUN），一个学习噪声感知价值场的神经算子，用于在未见几何中规划。基于随机最优控制的既定屏蔽泊松公式，我们解决两个挑战：指定支持跨不同几何导航的边界条件，以及高效计算具有可靠梯度的场。零狄利克雷障碍边界在墙壁处终止采样路径，削弱长路线上的目标信号并使其更难可靠估计。我们改为在障碍上施加反射诺伊曼条件，在目标处施加狄利克雷条件，允许采样路径继续探索自由空间直到到达目标。为了在没有配置空间网格的情况下求解所得PDE，我们将蒙特卡洛（MC）求解器Walk on Stars（WoSt）扩展到更高维度。然而，局部MC波动可能反转估计的梯度方向并导致规划失败，使直接规划需要昂贵的采样。PUN通过从噪声、部分收敛的蒙特卡洛标签学习几何到场映射来摊销此计算，避免每个训练示例的昂贵收敛。在推理时，

extra.description: Planning under uncertain control execution noise requires reliable feedback policies across diverse environments. We introduce Planning Under Noise (PUN), a neural operator that learns noise-aware value fields for planning in unseen geometries. Building on an established screened-Poisson formulation of stochastic optimal control, we address two challenges: specifying boundary conditions that support navigation across varying geometries and efficiently computing fields with reliable gradients. Zero-Dirichlet obstacle boundaries terminate sampled paths at walls, weakening the goal signal along long routes and making it harder to estimate reliably. We instead impose reflecting Neumann conditions on obstacles and a Dirichlet condition at the goal, allowing sampled paths to continue exploring free space until they reach the target. To solve the resulting PDE without a configuration-space mesh, we extend a Monte Carlo (MC) solver, Walk on Stars (WoSt), to higher dimensions. However, local MC fluctuations can reverse estimated gradient directions and cause planning failures, making direct planning require costly sampling. PUN amortizes this computation by learning geometry-to-field mappings from noisy, partially converged Monte Carlo labels, avoiding expensive convergence for every training example. At inference, test-time scaling uses bounded local search guided by the predicted global field. We evaluate PUN on planning tasks across dimensions. Across four noise levels, PUN matches or outperforms all compared planners, achieving 95-100% success on the 4D replanning benchmark while maintaining the lowest runtime. At the highest tested noise level in 4D, PUN achieves 10.7-60.6% relative gains in success rate over other methods while running 3.29-32.15 times faster.

items.title: MindView: Benchmarking Generative Multi-View Spatial Intelligence
items.title_zh: MindView：基准测试生成式多视图空间智能
items.summary_zh: 空间智能最近通过生成任务如空间接地图像编辑进行评估，然而从部分多视图观察进行语言引导的空间一致视图生成仍未充分探索。我们介绍MindView，一个生成式多视图空间智能基准，包含来自三个室内数据集513个场景的1,500个样本。其七项任务形成两个家族：几何主导任务指定相机位置和方向的变化，而语义主导任务需要通过接地所指对象并解释空间关系和参考框架线索来推断目标视点。对十一个生成器的评估揭示了MindView上的巨大改进空间。配对上下文分析进一步表明，所有十一个生成器在扩展上下文设置下获得更低的总体分数。这些发现促使我们研究任务特定监督是否可以改善目标视图生成，以及模型是否可以有效利用额外多视图证据。因此我们在MindView训练数据集上微调BAGEL，将其总体分数提高24.3分，并在所有七项MindView任务上产生增益。除了这些生成增益外，微调模型在三个空间理解基准上也获得更高分数，而无需

extra.description: Spatial intelligence has recently been assessed through generative tasks such as spatially grounded image editing, yet language-guided generation of spatially consistent views from partial multi-view observations remains underexplored. We introduce MindView, a benchmark for generative multi-view spatial intelligence with 1,500 samples from 513 scenes across three indoor datasets. Its seven tasks form two families: geometry-dominant tasks specify changes in camera position and orientation, while semantics-dominant tasks require inferring target viewpoints by grounding referred objects and interpreting spatial relations and reference-frame cues. Evaluation of eleven generators reveals substantial room for improvement on MindView. A paired context analysis further shows that all eleven generators obtain lower overall scores under the expanded context setting. These findings motivate us to investigate whether task-specific supervision can improve target-view generation and whether models can use additional multi-view evidence effectively. We therefore fine-tune BAGEL on the MindView training dataset, improving its overall score by 24.3 points and yielding gains across all seven MindView tasks. Beyond these generation gains, the fine-tuned model also yields higher scores on three spatial-understanding benchmarks without training on their annotations, suggesting that learning to generate spatially grounded views may benefit spatial understanding. To improve evidence utilization under expanded context, we propose MindCue, a training-free spatial evidence selector guided by a target-view hypothesis. MindCue reverses the drop in overall score under expanded context and outperforms the standard-context baseline. Overall, MindView provides a concrete testbed for generative multi-view spatial intelligence.

items.title: Efficient Edge-aware Attention Network for Graph Generation
items.title_zh: 用于图生成的高效边缘感知注意力网络
items.summary_zh: 图生成模型通常使用图专用Transformer架构来联合更新节点和边特征。然而，这些架构无法直接受益于近期硬件感知注意力实现，限制了其可扩展性。但适配并非易事：边和图级特征必须注入成对注意力分数，必须遵守图掩码，动态边更新仍是二次内存使用的主要来源。我们提出一种用于图生成的边感知注意力层，通过头级分数调制融入结构信息，同时用轻量级残差机制更新边表示，保留依赖注意力分数的边更新。该层可使用PyTorch的FlexAttention有效实现。我们在保持与基线相似的生成质量的同时，将峰值GPU内存降低约65%，并大幅提升训练和采样吞吐量。这些结果表明，所提架构是迈向可扩展图基础模型的切实一步。

extra.description: Graph generative models commonly use graph-specific Transformer architectures to jointly update node and edge features. However, these architectures do not directly benefit from recent hardware-aware attention implementations, limiting their scalability. The adaptation is, however, non-trivial: edge and graph-level features must be injected into pairwise attention scores, graph masks must be respected, and dynamic edge updates remain a major source of quadratic memory usage. We propose an edge-aware attention layer for graph generation that incorporates structural information through head-wise score modulation, while updating edge representations with a lightweight residual mechanism that retains attention-score dependent edge updates. This layer can be effectively implemented using PyTorch's FlexAttention. We achieve similar generation quality to our baseline while reducing peak GPU memory by around 65% and substantially improving training and sampling throughput. These results suggest that the proposed architecture is a practical step toward scalable graph foundation models.

items.title: Semantic Observability for Autonomous Systems Diagnostics
items.title_zh: 自主系统诊断的语义可观测性
items.summary_zh: 现代分布式微服务部署在物理和逻辑分区的基础设施上产生大量异构、多格式的可观测性日志。在级联故障期间隔离根因对站点可靠性工程师（SRE）而言仍是艰巨任务，受限于手动关键词过滤和监控仪表板间 disjointed 的时间关联。我们引入语义可观测性，一种自主多智能体框架，将分散的日志流统一为动态、可查询的属性图数据库。通过将物理基础设施拓扑、逻辑软件依赖和时间事件序列建模为带属性的节点和有向关系，它弥合了扁平、非结构化日志存储库中固有的语义鸿沟。在此统一基座上，我们部署了通过有向循环图（DCG）编排的有状态多智能体系统。系统自主导航拓扑，应用因果图算法和时间回溯来隔离异常的精确影响范围。剪枝后的子图随后由大语言模型（LLM）推理引擎解释，生成上下文相关的代码级根因分析（RCA）和可操作的修复措施。本文建立了语义可观测性的基础系统架构、形式化关系本体和多智能体控制循环。我们从概念上展示了该框架如何

extra.description: Modern distributed microservice deployments generate massive volumes of heterogeneous, multi-format observability logs across physically and logically partitioned infrastructure. Isolating root causes during cascading failures remains an arduous task for Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), bottlenecked by manual keyword filtering and disjointed temporal correlation across monitoring dashboards. We introduce Semantic Observability, an autonomous multi-agent framework that unifies disparate log streams into a dynamic, queryable Property Graph Database. By modeling physical infrastructure topologies, logical software dependencies, and chronological event sequences as attributed nodes and directed relations, it bridges the semantic gap inherent in flat, unstructured log repositories. Building on this unified substrate, we deploy a stateful multi-agent system orchestrated through Directed Cyclic Graphs (DCGs). The system autonomously navigates the topology, applying causal graph algorithms and temporal back-traversal to isolate the precise blast radius of anomalies. The pruned subgraph is then interpreted by a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning engine to generate contextualized, code-level Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and actionable remediations. This paper establishes the foundational system architecture, formal relational ontology, and multi-agent control loops of Semantic Observability. We show conceptually how the framework eliminates ambient telemetry noise, reduces Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR), compresses LLM token consumption, and prevents structural hallucinations. We also specify an open-source validation framework on standard benchmarks (LogHub and Train-Ticket), laying the groundwork for a forthcoming companion paper on exhaustive quantitative evaluation and production benchmarking.

items.title: Benchmarking Arabic Dialects for Math Problems
items.title_zh: 阿拉伯语方言数学问题基准测试
items.summary_zh: 数学推理在低资源语言（包括方言阿拉伯语）中仍未被充分探索。为弥合这一差距，我们引入DAR-MGSM（方言阿拉伯语多语言小学数学校准）基准，这是首个用于评估方言阿拉伯语数学推理的手动策划基准。DAR-MGSM由需要多步推理的数学应用题（MWP）组成，涵盖五种主要阿拉伯语方言以及现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）。该基准包含两个平行版本：仅翻译版和翻译+文化本地化版。后者将实体和引用适配为地区变体。我们在DAR-MGSM上评估了十一个以阿拉伯语为中心和多语言的大语言模型。结果表明，本地化版本上的性能普遍下降，突显了文化根基适配带来的挑战。然而，这种影响的程度因模型而异，以阿拉伯语为中心的模型对本地化表现出不同水平的敏感性。机制可解释性分析表明，同一MWP的翻译版和本地化版通常诱导出不同的内部推理轨迹，即使总体准确率保持相似。总体而言，我们的结果表明数学推理性能取决于语言变体和文化背景。

extra.description: Mathematical reasoning remains underexplored for low-resource languages, including Dialectal Arabic. To bridge this gap, we introduce the DAR-MGSM (Dialectal Arabic Multilingual Grade School Math) Benchmark, the first manually curated benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning in Dialectal Arabic. DAR-MGSM consists of math word problems (MWPs) requiring multi-step reasoning and covers five major Arabic dialects alongside Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). The benchmark comprises two parallel versions: translated-only and translated & culturally localized. The latter version adapts entities and references to regional varieties. We evaluate eleven Arabic-centric and multilingual large language models on DAR-MGSM. The results show that the performance generally declines on the localized version, highlighting the challenges introduced by culturally grounded adaptations. However, the magnitude of this effect varies across models, with Arabic-centric models exhibiting different levels of sensitivity to localization. A mechanistic interpretability analysis shows that translated and localized variants of the same MWPs often induce distinct internal reasoning trajectories, even when aggregate accuracy remains similar. Overall, our results show that mathematical reasoning performance depends on both linguistic variety and cultural context.

items.title: Tensorizing Pairwise Structural Analysis: GPU-Accelerated RMSD and FCC Clustering in HADDOCK3 Without Structural Regression.
items.title_zh: 张量化成对结构分析：HADDOCK3中GPU加速的RMSD和FCC聚类且无结构回归。
items.summary_zh: 整合性大分子对接流程生成数千个候选结构诱饵，依赖下游成对集成分析，包括均方根偏差（RMSD）矩阵和共同接触分数（FCC）聚类，以识别生物学相关的结合姿态。然而，成对结构比较按二次方（O(N^2)）扩展，HADDOCK3中的规范工作流历史上依赖磁盘绑定的轨迹序列化和迭代CPU集合操作，为大型集成造成二次计算和存储瓶颈。在此，我们证明这些操作可重新表述为GPU驻留张量上的连续线性代数：通过批量奇异值分解（SVD）进行结构叠加，通过二进制矩阵乘法（M = A A^T）进行残基接触重叠。在跨越N = 200至10,000个模型（评估多达49,995,000个诱饵对）的经验基准中，我们的GPU实现在Apple Silicon（MPS）上实现6.41倍计算加速，在N = 5,000的NVIDIA CUDA消融中通过消除轨迹磁盘I/O实现高达12.2倍的端到端加速。关键的是，该实现相对于规范基线实现零下

extra.description: Integrative macromolecular docking pipelines generate thousands of candidate structural decoys, relying on downstream pairwise ensemble analysis, including Root-Mean-Square Deviation (RMSD) matrices and Fraction of Common Contacts (FCC) clustering, to identify biologically relevant binding poses. However, pairwise structural comparisons scale quadratically (O(N^2)), and canonical workflows in HADDOCK3 historically rely on disk-bound trajectory serialization and iterative CPU set operations, creating a quadratic computational and storage bottleneck for large ensembles. Here, we demonstrate that these operations can be reformulated as continuous linear algebra on GPU-resident tensors: structural superposition via batched Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and residue contact overlap via binary matrix multiplication (M = A A^T). Across empirical benchmarks spanning N = 200 to 10,000 models (evaluating up to 49,995,000 decoy pairs), our GPU implementation achieves a 6.41-fold compute speedup on Apple Silicon (MPS) and up to 12.2-fold end-to-end acceleration in an N = 5,000 ablation on NVIDIA CUDA by eliminating trajectory disk I/O. Crucially, the implementation achieves zero downstream structural regression relative to canonical baselines, preserving identical cluster assignments (Adjusted Rand Index ARI = 1.0000, zero differing assignments) with sub-microangstrom RMSD concordance (Delta_max <= 4.07 x 10^-7 Angstrom on single-precision MPS; machine-precision Delta_max <= 8.88 x 10^-16 Angstrom on double-precision CUDA). The accelerated code, test suites, and benchmarking workflows are openly accessible on GitHub under the Apache-2.0 license.

items.title: PATHNet: A Thermodynamic Path-Integral-Inspired Neural Network for Protein-Ligand Interaction Prediction
items.title_zh: PATHNet：一种热力学路径积分启发的神经网络用于蛋白质-配体相互作用预测
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质-配体评分函数必须捕捉强非线性、靶标依赖的结合物理，同时保持超越训练数据的泛化能力，这一平衡是纯分析和纯数据驱动模型各自难以单独实现的。我们提出PATHNet，一个物理信息框架，使用具有有界神经网络校正的非单调分段线性映射器从分子力学描述符中学习这种未知函数关系，通过变分、最小作用启发的目标训练，并受重整化群启发的谱约束调节，模型选择通过多起点盆地优化进行。在七个DUD-E靶标上，PATHNet在测试方法中实现了最高的平均活性/诱饵分类准确率，优于代表不同架构家族的三个文献基线。这些结果支持基于物理、变分约束的神经网络评分方法，作为通向更可解释和可迁移的蛋白质-配体相互作用模型的实用途径。

extra.description: Protein-ligand scoring functions must capture strongly nonlinear, target-dependent binding physics while remaining generalizable beyond their training data, a balance that purely analytic and purely data-driven models each struggle to achieve on their own. We present PATHNet, a physics-informed framework that learns this unknown functional relationship from molecular-mechanics descriptors using a non-monotonic piecewise-linear mapper with a bounded neural-network correction, trained through a variational, least-action-inspired objective and regulated by a renormalization-group-inspired spectral constraint, with model selection performed through multi-start basin optimization. Across seven DUD-E targets, PATHNet achieved the highest mean active inactive/decoy classification accuracy among the methods tested, outperforming three literature baselines representing distinct architectural families. These results support a physics-grounded, variationally constrained approach to neural-network scoring as a practical route toward more interpretable and transferable protein-ligand interaction models.

items.title: Spatial Single-Cell Mapping of Transcriptional Differences Across Genetic Backgrounds in Mouse Brains
items.title_zh: 小鼠大脑中跨遗传背景转录差异的空间单细胞映射
items.summary_zh: 遗传变异可以改变器官结构，进而改变功能。跨遗传背景的器官比较统计分析需要重复的空间、单细胞、图谱规模数据，而当前技术无法大规模提供。我们引入ATLAS（使用聚合签名的图谱规模转录组定位），一种可扩展的组织映射方法。ATLAS从scRNAseq数据学习转录签名，用数万个寡核苷酸探针原位编码，并解码以推断细胞类型和插补转录组。我们通过将ATLAS的细胞类型推断与标记基因的直接MERFISH测量进行比较，并与另外四种技术进行定量比较，在小鼠大脑中验证了ATLAS。使用ATLAS，我们映射了五只雄性和五只雌性C57BL/6J（B6）小鼠以及五只雄性BTBR T+ tf/J（BTBR）小鼠（一种特发性自闭症模型）的中心大脑，在400多个冠状切片上共分析了4000万个细胞。我们的分析揭示了细胞类型分布中超过40个显著差异，并在雄-雌和B6-BTBR比较中识别出16个区域组成变化。因此，ATLAS能够实

extra.description: Genetic variation can alter organ structure and, in turn, function. Comparative statistical analysis of organs across genetic backgrounds requires spatial, single-cell, atlas-scale data in replicates, which current technologies do not provide at scale. We introduce Atlas-scale Transcriptome Localization using Aggregate Signatures (ATLAS), a scalable tissue mapping method. ATLAS learns transcriptional signatures from scRNAseq data, encodes them in situ with tens of thousands of oligonucleotide probes, and decodes them to infer cell types and imputed transcriptomes. We validated ATLAS in the mouse brain by comparing its cell type inferences with direct MERFISH measurements of marker genes and quantitative comparisons to four other technologies. Using ATLAS, we mapped the central brains of five male and five female C57BL/6J (B6) mice and five male BTBR T+ tf/J (BTBR) mice, an idiopathic model of autism, collectively profiling 40 million cells across over 400 coronal sections. Our analysis revealed over 40 significant differences in cell type distributions and identified 16 regional composition changes across male-female and B6-BTBR comparisons. ATLAS thus enables systematic comparative studies, facilitating organ-level structure-function analysis of disease models.

items.title: 泽连斯基表示，乌克兰愿在保留至少75%领土控制权的基础上达成和平协议，你怎么看？
items.title_zh: 泽连斯基表示，乌克兰愿在保留至少75%领土控制权的基础上达成和平协议，你怎么看？
items.summary_zh: 据央视新闻消息，当地时间10月21日，乌克兰总统泽连斯基在接受采访时表示，乌方可在保留至少75%领土控制权的基础上达成和平协议。 主持人向泽连斯基提问称，他是否愿意接受一项和平协议，把一切按现状冻结下来，乌方仍然保有75%或更多的国土。泽连斯基予以肯定回答，称“现在我们必须冻结（战线），这是结束这场战争的切实办法。”（总台记者 董薇）泽连斯基：愿在保留至少75%领土控制权的基础上达成和平协议 - 新京报泽连斯基：愿在保留75%领土控制权的基础上达成和平协议

items.title_zh: 星巴克中国称10月22日起将在全国开始施行消费入座，你支持吗？消费入座对门店业绩和顾客体验有哪些影响？
items.summary_zh: 10月21日，澎湃新闻记者从星巴克中国方面获悉，10月22日起，星巴克将在全国开始施行消费入座，门店会摆放相关提示牌。在实际的营运过程中，星巴克会为伙伴提供统一的服务指引和必要支持，伙伴会遵循友好、友善的沟通原则，并妥善处理顾客的合理突发需求和特殊情况。 星巴克方面表示，如遇到孕妇、行动不便者等需要帮助的顾客，伙伴将优先给予帮助。规则清晰，但执行会保有温度，“人文关怀始终是我们的应有之义，我们将持续投入资源改善门店体验，并与顾客共同创造和维护第三空间的美好体验。”星巴克中国：10月22日起将在全国开始施行消费入座

items.title: 如何看待人民锐评发表文章「特斯拉能飞，我们就被甩开了？」，中国汽车行业未来该如何发展？
items.title_zh: 如何看待人民锐评发表文章「特斯拉能飞，我们就被甩开了？」，中国汽车行业未来该如何发展？
items.summary_zh: 最近，特斯拉发布“会飞的汽车”，引发热议。有人惊呼“我们被甩开了”；也有人嗤之以鼻，称其不过是“蹦高的大号玩具”。两种论断各走极端，过于武断。那么，热闹之后，我们当以怎样的眼光和格局，看待这样一场技术展示？ 首先，要有一份清醒的定力。不必妄自菲薄，切莫一看见新鲜演示，就全盘否定中国新能源汽车攒下的家底。 特斯拉这次“飞行”，靠的是冷气推进系统等实现短时腾空、空中翻转，确实炫酷。可法规、场景、安全认证，样样还是未知数；又有多少人愿意坐在两个大压缩罐前开车，恐怕也得打个问号。目前，官方给出2028年的量产预期，但比起一款能日常开的车，它更像一场漂亮的概念秀。 而中国汽车手里攥着的，是一套系统性的硬功夫：看速度，比亚迪仰望U9 Xtreme以496.22km/h的成绩，登顶世界汽车极速榜首；看充电，宁德时代第三代神行超充电池，6分钟常温满电，刷新全球纪录；看智驾，华为、理想等发布舱驾一体或端到端

items.title: 医保个人账户跨省共济落地全国，意味着什么？将带来哪些利好？
items.title_zh: 医保个人账户跨省共济落地全国，意味着什么？将带来哪些利好？
items.summary_zh: 近日，国家医保局上线医保钱包2.0版。自10月16日起，全国各省、自治区、直辖市及新疆生产建设兵团已全部上线运行，职工医保个人账户跨省共济在全国全面落地。 职工医保个人账户跨省共济，依托全国统一医保信息平台设立个人医保钱包、设置共济额度，实现职工个人账户资金按规定支付近亲属在定点医药机构就医、购药发生的个人负担费用，以及参保缴费。 国家医保局医保中心相关负责人解释，医保钱包是跨省共济的载体与桥梁，实行虚拟额度管理，并非实体资金账户，医保基金不会实际拨付进入医保钱包，全程遵守医保基金监管要求。 在跨省共济对象上，共济人须为正常参保职工医保人员；被共济人为外省职工医保或居民医保参保人，仅限近亲属：配偶、父母、子女、兄弟姐妹、祖父母、外祖父母、孙子女、外孙子女，除此之外的其他人不能作为被共济对象。 数据显示，截至2025年末，医保个人账户累计结存15080.16亿元，五年增长28.3%，约占医保

items.title_zh: 一家三口被困酒店卫生间超4小时，其间消防喷淋失控致婴儿险失温，当事人索赔15万，从法律角度如何解读？
items.summary_zh: 卫生间门锁故障反锁 一家三口求救无门 傅先生告诉记者，9月30日晚9点多，他和妻子准备给年幼的宝宝洗澡。考虑到洗浴时间较短，夫妻俩并未携带手机进入卫生间。未曾想洗浴结束后，随手关上的卫生间门锁突发故障、自动反锁，从内部无法开启，一家三口被困在狭小的卫生间内。 卫生间门锁坏了导致门反锁 夫妻二人变换各种角度，反复按压马桶旁的SOS紧急呼叫按钮，但全程没有任何应答，也无工作人员前来排查。狭小空间内室温较低，孩子赤裸身体极易着凉。傅先生随即打开花洒，放热水，想用蒸汽提升室温。可短暂升温后，卫生间顶部两个消防喷淋头突然同时启动，冰冷的高压水流倾泻而下。 看着浑身赤裸、受惊吓大哭的孩子，傅先生心急如焚，拿起铁质垃圾桶猛砸卫生间钢化采光玻璃，试图破窗逃生，但钢化玻璃质地坚硬，多次撞击均未能砸开，还导致他右手手腕软骨骨折。为尽快逃出，他又撞门，但因地面全是积水，他又滑倒摔断了肋骨。 喷淋失控喷水超两小时

items.summary_zh: 观察者网专栏作者 李煜华：今年9月，我刚刚到巴黎社会学与政治学研究中心访问，没想到很快就亲历了一场席卷全法的全国性抗议浪潮，也得以近距离观察这场骚乱如何一步步从小范围的利益诉求，演变为整个法国社会不满情绪的总爆发。 刚刚过去的周六（10月17日），抗议浪潮达到一个新高峰。在巴黎克利希广场附近，大批示威者沿着马真塔大道向北行进。人群里年轻人居多，大多不过十几二十岁，但也不乏中年人和头发花白的老人。有人身披旗帜，有人举着手写标语，还有人推着音响，带领周围的人群唱歌。鼓点、歌声和口号此起彼伏，游行队伍沿着宽阔的大道一路延伸，汇入克利希广场。 因为局势紧张，笔者家附近的一家商店暂停营业 人群中还不乏颇为奇特的装扮。有人打扮成《海贼王》《火影忍者》中的人物，还有人扮成蝙蝠侠，穿行于挥舞旗帜的示威者之间。一些年轻人爬上路灯杆和公交站牌，试图占据更高的位置。克利希广场中央，纪念1814年巴黎保卫战的蒙塞

items.title: 陶哲轩和邓煜的对谈《数学与 AI 究竟是什么关系？》，如何理解他们各自的观点？
items.title_zh: 陶哲轩和邓煜的对谈《数学与 AI 究竟是什么关系？》，如何理解他们各自的观点？
items.summary_zh: 有了这些模型，人的哪些方面能力会变得重要？它怎样才能与人合作，真正帮助人而不是取代人？ 陶哲轩 关键是增强人的能力。也就是说，要设法为科学家提供工具，也为从业者等人提供工具，让他们的能力真正增强。当你使用这些工具时，你自己也会变得更聪明，理解得更深，而不是牺牲自己的能力，依赖 AI 来获得答案。 所以还是那句话，任何技术都是如此。拿汽车来说，如果到哪儿都开车，久而久之，你会忘了怎么走路，或者身体变差，但这并不意味着你该彻底放弃汽车。你需要有意识、有分寸地使用这些交通工具。 而且我觉得，我们可以相信大家，尤其是年轻一代。眼下可能有很多焦虑，甚至绝望，因为许多数学领域的老规矩都在发生变化。但一旦大家明白可以做些什么，尤其是当工具真正到了他们手里，他们就会迎接挑战，想出极富创意的新做法，让我们忍不住惊叹，我怎么没想到呢？这太棒了。我对年轻一代充满希望，只要有合适的工具，他们就能做出惊人的成果。

items.summary_zh: 港媒曝刘恺威与32岁黎纪君恋情，两人因匹克球互生情愫，已秘密恋爱两个月。近日，两人被拍到牵手外出，一起在外吃饭，全程动作都十分亲昵。聚餐结束后黎纪君坐上刘恺威车，一同回到黎纪君住所整晚没有离开。据悉，2024年刘丹曾暗示刘恺威与李晓峰已分手，今年5月刘恺威被曝新恋情，随后否认，6月刘丹称刘恺威单身。

items.title: 连英伟达都承认消费级显卡已超出其控制，AI 显卡内存涨价狂潮何时结束?
items.title_zh: 连英伟达都承认消费级显卡已超出其控制，AI 显卡内存涨价狂潮何时结束?
items.summary_zh: 面对全球玩家一卡难求、旗舰显卡价格翻数倍的窘境，英伟达回应“超出控制”。 近日，英伟达开发者关系副总裁艾达·凯塔（Ida Keita）在首尔三成洞COEX举行的RTX Spark发布会后接受媒体采访时表示，消费级图形处理器（GPU）短缺的根源在于内存供应不足，而这“不是英伟达能够控制的事情”。 问题出在整个半导体供应链 凯塔指出，包括游戏玩家在内的消费者面临的供应困难，反映的是更广泛的半导体供应链问题——这些问题不仅涉及GPU本身，还涉及DRAM。“这不是英伟达能够控制的事情，”他在回答有关消费级GPU短缺的问题时说道。 英伟达：消费级GPU短缺“超出控制”，内存涨价潮短期难解-电子工程专辑https://www.eet-china.com/news/202610197203.html 根据韩媒THE ELEC报道，最近英伟达副总裁在RTX Spark 发布活动上被问到游戏显卡供应短缺的问

items.title: 女子下班后绕道买菜，遭遇车祸身亡，人社部门不予认定工伤，法院判决算工伤，如何理解？
items.title_zh: 女子下班后绕道买菜，遭遇车祸身亡，人社部门不予认定工伤，法院判决算工伤，如何理解？
items.summary_zh: 据《法治日报》，员工李某下班后没有直接回家，计划采购葱、姜、蔬菜等日常食材。从单位到李某住处的沿途虽然有三家超市，但都不出售蔬菜，李某只能绕道前往定期开市的集市采买蔬菜。返程途中，李某遭遇车祸不幸身亡。李某这次绕行能否被认定为“上下班途中”，他的死亡又能否认定为工伤？ 今年6月，山东省临沂市平邑县人民法院审结了这起工伤保险资格认定纠纷案。 2025年11月，李某结束当天工作后，驾驶电动车前往位于甲公司正东方向的B村集市，采购葱、姜、蔬菜等日常食材。该集市距离甲公司约1.5公里，骑行仅需约6分钟。采购完成后，李某沿原路返回住处，途中与一辆重型自卸货车相撞，身受重伤，经送医抢救后仍不幸离世。交警部门经调查认定，李某对本次事故承担次要责任。从李某下班离岗到事故发生，前后仅相隔约25分钟。 交警部门认定李某负事故次要责任，但相关人社部门认为该绕行不属于上下班途中，作出了不予认定工伤的决定。 法院审
